text:
Nina CSM: Quick ask 44 Brightfield asked for a "lite" hands-on session to boost usage before their renewal review next Tue. They want a 75min workshop + 15m follow-up office hours. Can we run Sun 08:00-09:30 UTC? (APAC-friendly)
Rafi Enablement: I can run a condensed lab: 60m guided exercises + 15m live test runs. Need a backup for the final office hours 15m.
Ally AM: I can cover the 15m office hours and handle billing/contract Qs.
Theo Ops: Logistics note: please use staging tenant and enable recording + auto-transcript. Also set attendee limit to 40 and enable waiting room.
Nina CSM: I'll prep a 1-page pre-read and a 5-question intake survey to capture primary pain points. survey-bot: Survey created: https://forms.redwood.com/brightfield-prework (5 q). Reminders set.
Rafi Enablement: Draft agenda:
 - 00:00-05:00 Intro & goals (Nina)
 - 05:00-20:00 Quick product highlights + billing note (Ally)
 - 20:00-80:00 Lab: import, prompt tuning, local eval harness (Rafi)
 - 80:00-90:00 Office hours & next steps (Ally)
Nina CSM: Lab will include a tiny eval they can run in 5 commands. I'll attach the snippet to the invite.
Theo Ops: Please confirm staging dataset is pre-loaded. I see an outstanding task: anonymize PII in the sample rows. Who owns that?
Rafi Enablement: I can scrub example prompts during my prep. If there are customer-specific records, ask Brightfield to point to test rows.
Ally AM: I'll nudge the customer to complete the intake survey and ask for 3 example prompts they'd like to improve.
Nina CSM: Calendar? I can create the Zoom event and add calendar-bot for 48h/2h reminders.
calendar-bot: Event scheduled: Brightfield Renewal Lab 022-03-19 08:00 UTC. Reminders: 48h and 2h. Recording enabled.
Theo Ops: Also add a short runbook in the invite notes: troubleshooting steps + support contact. Example snippet:```bash
# quick health check
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
```
Rafi Enablement: I'll paste the 5-check eval harness into the invite and demo running it in the lab.
Nina CSM: Post-session actions: 1) upload recording & transcript, 2) populate action tracker, 3) flag renewal health. I propose: if usage doesn't increase 48h, escalate to AM for targeted outreach. Agree?
Ally AM: Agree. I'll follow up on any billing/contract asks and draft a Dedicated ROI note if they ask.
survey-bot: Reminder sent to attendees: complete prework (3 prompts + intent). 12/30 completed so far.
Rafi Enablement: One last ask: can we get a point person from their engineering team to join for the lab? We need at least one engineer for API keys and network questions.
Nina CSM: I'll request an engineer on the invite and mark it as recommended.
Theo Ops: Doc link for action tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/brightfield/lab-actions (edit perms to team).
Ally AM: All set here. If no major blockers, please send the invite and I'll prep the Dedicated ROI slide.
Nina CSM: Sending invite now. Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
calendar-bot: Invite sent and attendees invited.
Nina CSM: Final note: I'll set renewal health to "watch" and update to "green" if we see +15% usage within 48h after the lab. Otherwise escalate.
